title: Standing Orders
summary: The Academy's statutes say what a guild needs: a fire, a quorum, a doorway the world can knock on, and standing orders, so the house still stands when the sitting rises. The Register has the fire. Until the door is set, the campus is shut and the moon will not turn.

objectives.text: Light the castle from the Grand Hall's hearth and take it out of the gate
objectives.doneText: A fire: the castle is lit and out of the gate

objectives.text: Refuel the castle at the Academy's field store
objectives.doneText: Provisions: the castle is fueled for the road

objectives.text: Gather a quorum: three members on the roll
objectives.doneText: A quorum: three members on the roll

objectives.text: Set the door at the Academy's field house
objectives.doneText: A doorway: the door is set

objectives.text: Adopt the standing orders in the Grand Hall
